title: What Shall I Use As Bait?
speaker: Pastor Erica Roth
description: Pastor Erica Roth delivered an inspiring sermon titled "What Shall I Use As Bait?" based on Luke 5:1-11. Her message explored the deep and transformative call to become "fishers of men and women" as Jesus invited Simon Peter to do. Pastor Erica challenged us to reflect on what we use as "bait" in our lives to draw others to Christ, emphasizing the power of love and authentic living.
